title: Andhra Medical Student Declared Brain Dead After SUV Crash
summary: An SUV ran over an Andhra medical student outside a mall in Rajahmundry. The student, identified as [name], was declared brain dead hours later. Police claimed the driver of the SUV had lost control while driving at high speed. The government said it would investigate the incident and ensure road safety measures are implemented. The opposition alleged that the government's lack of action on road safety led to this tragedy.
summary_points: An SUV ran over an Andhra medical student outside a mall in Rajahmundry.
